Subject: Follow-up: retest request for BWH findings (BWH-PT-2027-03)

Hi Grace,

Thanks for the initial remediation notes in your portal. Our pen-test vendor completed the external assessment last month and recorded a small set of medium/low findings (ref: BWH-PT-2027-03). Before we mark the ticket closed on our side we need: 

- A short remediation summary per finding (what was changed, config values, and why the change mitigates risk)
- Evidence artifacts we can consume (patch IDs, screenshots of config, staging verification scans)
- Confirmation whether the scope, assets, or authentication flow changed since the original test

Procurement is also asking for a limited-scope retest attestation/letter we can keep on file for audit — ideally addressed to BlueWave Procurement.

Can you confirm whether BlueWave is OK for a focused spot-check retest (limited to the three medium findings and their immediate dependencies) and provide the requested artifacts by end of next week?

If you can share a proposed retest window that would help us coordinate the vendor.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

— Jordan Park
BlueWave Security (on behalf of the assessment team)
security@bluewavehealth.com

Hi Jordan / BlueWave team,

Thanks for the note and for the vendor summary — appreciated. We can absolutely support a limited-scope spot-check retest focused on the three medium findings you flagged. Short answers up front:

- Scope changes: none to production-facing assets. We applied targeted code/config fixes on the services noted; there were small ACL adjustments on the staging proxy during remediation testing but production access flows were unchanged.
- Evidence: attaching a remediation checklist and a small evidence bundle (staging screenshots, patch IDs, and the quick verification runbook). The full evidence bundle will be uploaded to the shared Drive link below.
- Proposed retest window: Tue, Mar 30 — Wed, Mar 31 (09:00–17:00 PST). We will provide a dedicated contact and make a short-lived test account and temp logs available.

Request: for the retest to be efficient please scope the vendor to the three findings only (BWH-03, BWH-07, BWH-12). We will not re-open unrelated findings during this spot-check; if new issues are discovered we can triage them after the retest.

Attachments included: remediation_checklist.xlsx (high-level mapping to findings) and a small proof bundle. Full evidence is at: https://drive.redwood.ai/shared/bluewave/pt_evidence_2027 (read-only link).

If that schedule works for you, please confirm and we will provision the test credentials and a shared Slack channel.

Regards,

Grace — that timeline looks good. We will schedule the vendor for Tue/Wed this week and scope them to BWH-03, BWH-07, BWH-12 only. Procurement asked if you can provide a short delta attestation letter (one page) addressed to Procurement — confirming the three findings were remediated and that this retest is a limited spot-check, not a full regression assessment.

One clarification from the vendor: BWH-07 referenced an outdated third-party library (lib-crypto v1.2.3). Did remediation include an upgrade or a compensating control? If it was an upgrade, can you provide the new dependency pin so we can check SBOM matches?

Procurement will expect the attestation before we close the procurement compliance task; however, they are happy to proceed with the retest in parallel.

Jordan / Procurement team,

Thanks — vendor retest completed this morning. Quick summary and items enclosed: 

- BWH-03: fixed — configuration hardened (removed unsafe header passthrough). Verification: staging + canary scan; patch ID: RDFX-2027-03-77.
- BWH-07: upgraded lib-crypto from v1.2.3 -> v1.3.1 and added CI-level SBOM validation for that dependency. SBOM reference: sbom-redwood-20270329.json.
- BWH-12: applied scoped input validation and tightened the WAF rule set for the endpoint; verification: dynamic test logs attached.

Per your procurement ask, attached is a short delta attestation letter addressed to BlueWave Procurement confirming: (a) remediation completed as described above, (b) the retest performed was a limited spot-check scoped to the three findings, and (c) no production-scope changes were introduced beyond the listed fixes. This letter is intended for your audit folder — not a replacement for a full regression assessment.

Attachments in this email: delta_attestation_letter_20270330.pdf, remediation_evidence_bundle.zip (contains patch IDs, SBOM excerpt, verification screenshots, and quick-run logs). The full evidence set is on the shared Drive link.

If procurement needs any edits to the attestation wording, let us know and we will adjust promptly. Also looping Rishi and Vivek in case you need deeper technical follow-up.

Thanks for coordinating — happy to hop on a short call if that helps close the loop.

Best,
